examples.name: Classes and Objects
examples.description: Object-oriented programming with implicit member access
examples.learningGoal: Learn how MALDA groups data and behavior into classes and objects.
examples.expectedOutput: Creates objects and calls methods on them.

examples.name: Inheritance
examples.description: Class inheritance and polymorphism with implicit member access
examples.learningGoal: See how one class can reuse and extend another class in MALDA.
examples.expectedOutput: Demonstrates inherited behavior and overridden methods.

examples.name: Static Members
examples.learningGoal: Understand when data belongs to the class itself instead of to a specific object.
examples.expectedOutput: Shows shared values or methods accessed through the class.

examples.name: Complex Example - Calculator
examples.description: Complete example with classes, methods, and logic
examples.learningGoal: Practice OOP with a complete but approachable program that still feels like real software.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints calculator results for several operations, including division-by-zero handling.
